judge.window: runs of whole sentences of at most 80 tokens, consecutive runs sharing a sentence where a run holds two or more; a longer sentence is split into overlapping token pieces; the premise is truncated to the window as a final cap; carried if any window entails
judge.too_long_rule: a sentence that cannot fit beside a full window is counted as not carried

premise: the notes joined one per line
measures: which of the text's frozen atomic claims the notes state, for one NLI judge
